instruction: Return ONLY one JSON object matching `schema`, with no text before or after it. Give the canonical_task of the task folder first, then identify this episode's task and count its cycles (repetitions) using the views provided in video_order together (head, left wrist, right wrist, or the head alone). Give only the number of cycles and the three confidences (canonical_task.confidence, task.confidence, n_repetitions_confidence, each 0 to 1): no step segments, no reasoning and no time. Do not add keys that are not in the schema. canonical_task.task_family and task.task_family must be one of vocabulary.task_families. Neither canonical_task nor task may be calibration, inspection, testing or any other setup activity.

fields.canonical_task.task_text: one generic sentence: the goal of a single repetition of the task this task folder was recorded for, the same wording for every episode of the folder; never calibration, inspection or setup
fields.canonical_task.task_family: one of vocabulary.task_families ('other' only when none fits)
fields.canonical_task.action: 3 to 7 word imperative phrase, generic (object type and destination type)
fields.canonical_task.object_categories: generic object types of the folder's task (e.g. 'LED', 'plastic container'), no colours or counts
fields.canonical_task.confidence: 0 to 1: how sure you are that every episode of the task folder would get this label
fields.task.task_text: one sentence: the goal of a single repetition in this episode (normally canonical_task with this episode's objects)
fields.task.task_family: one of vocabulary.task_families ('other' only when none fits)
fields.task.object_categories: list of object names or categories handled (may differ between repetitions); name only what you can see, as specifically as the video allows
fields.task.confidence: 0 to 1: how sure you are that this episode shows this task as named
fields.n_repetitions: number of complete cycles of the task in this episode (an integer; 0 only when no complete cycle is seen)
fields.n_repetitions_confidence: 0 to 1: how sure you are that n_repetitions is exactly right (lower when objects are tiny or occluded, boundaries are unclear or cycles are cut by the recording's start or end)

code_checks_after_response: at least 3 repetitions, else flag the recording (do not edit the count)
each confidence must be a number from 0 to 1; values below 0.5 are flagged for human review (the answer is never edited)
word limits (action 3 to 7 words) are checked in code and flagged
the count is a first pass: it is reviewed and corrected by a human (HITL) afterwards

optional cross-check: compare n_repetitions with the gripper close/open cycle count measured from robot{0,1}/gripper/state of the same MCAP (umi.tag_tracking.annotation) and report disagreement; never overwrite the model count

schema.title: UMI canonical task, task and cycle count per episode (VLM response)
